programmes.d: The life of a small girl is endangered because she is the only witness to the shooting of her mother.
A gunrunner gets the Pawnees mad in order to sell his weapons.
The people of Dodge gets suspicious of Jim Cobbett when his second wifevanishes just like his first.
A man who saved Matt Dillon's life 10 years earlier turns up in Dodge City—again in the role of Good Samaritan.
To save his own life, murder witness Doc gives his word of honor to the killers (including Claude Akins) that he won't expose them.
The shooting of several members of an outlaw gang, though in self defense, triggers an emotional crisis in Matt, haunted by memories of all the men he has killed.
An outlaw holds up a stagecoach carrying a murderer to trial.
Victor French guest stars as Sheriff Bo Harker, a town tamer who keeps his citizens in line with fear and brutality.
Matt tells a pair of gamblers to get out of Dodge, but they hire a gunman to kill him.
A vengeful judge accuses Kitty and Festus of conspiracy in the killing of his son.
Marshal Dillon finds out about the fury of a woman scorned when he spurns the advances of an outlaw's girlfriend.
Marshal Dillon determines to catch a cold-eyed gunslinger who has killed a sheriff and a priest in a small Kansas town.
With Matt out of town, Doc only has Chester to protect him when his life is threatened.
Marshal Dillon is helped by a friendly young runaway who later faces him as a deadly adversary.
A well-liked hardware drummer is actually a man wanted for multiple murders.
Matt refuses to turn in a rustler for a court-martial. Boot Hill intro clearly shows grave markers with dates of 1882 & 1883, yet episode is set in 1876, the year of the Battle of the Little Bighorn.
A mature woman and her attractive niece find their lives and plans totally altered by a temporary stop in Dodge City.
An outlaw kidnaps a baby to give himself respectability as he plans to rob the Dodge City bank.
A plot to kill Marshal Dillon goes awry when the hired gunman falls in love and hires someone else to do the job for him. (TV-PG)
Print Asper wishes to leave his ranch to his sons, but his attorney has other plans.
When Chester's mail-order bride arrives, neither she nor Chester are what the other are expecting.
Matt must prove his innocence when he is accused of beating a man to death.
Matt has to stop a cold-blooded killer who preys on over-matched opponents.
